stem: The correct salutation in a letter to the editor is

label: PYQ-style
stem: You are Arjun/Arpita, a resident of Sector 21, Noida. Garbage has not been collected from your locality for over two weeks and the heaps near the park are attracting stray animals and mosquitoes. Write a letter in 120–150 words to the editor of a national daily drawing the attention of the municipal authorities to the problem and suggesting measures.
hint: Shell with The Editor + paper + city, subject, Sir,. P1 esteemed-newspaper line; P2 two or three specifics (two weeks, heaps near park, strays, mosquitoes, health risk); P3 suggestions + who should act + hope for action.
model_answer:
H-204, Sector 21
Noida 201301
14 November 2026
The Editor
The Times of India
New Delhi
Subject: Uncollected garbage in Sector 21
Sir,
Through the columns of your esteemed newspaper I wish to draw the attention of the Noida Authority to the uncollected garbage in Sector 21.
For over two weeks no municipal van has visited our lanes. Heaps of waste have piled up near the children's park and the market. Stray dogs and cattle tear the bags open, and the stagnant water around them is breeding mosquitoes. With dengue cases already rising in the city, residents, especially children and the elderly, are at serious risk, and the stench makes the park unusable.
I request the authorities to restore daily collection immediately, clear the existing heaps, spray the area and fine those who dump waste in the open. Residents, too, should segregate waste at home.
I hope prompt action will be taken.
Yours sincerely,
Arpita
(A concerned resident)

scheme.step: Format: sender's address, date, The Editor with paper and city, subject, Sir, close, name
Content: purpose stated with the esteemed-newspaper line; problem with specifics (two weeks, heaps, strays, mosquitoes, health risk)
Content: suggestions and the authority who should act; hope for prompt action
Expression: formal register, coherence and paragraphing
Expression: grammar, spelling, 120–150 words

label: PYQ-style
stem: You are Karan/Kavya of 18, MG Road, Bengaluru. You bought a laptop from Techno World, Brigade Road, on 2 November 2026 (Bill No. TW/4521). Within a week the screen started flickering and the battery drains in an hour. Write a letter of complaint in 120–150 words to the Manager asking for a replacement or a refund.
hint: Shell with The Manager, shop, address; subject; Sir/Madam. P2 must carry item, date, bill number, two defects, inconvenience. P3 one remedy within a time, bill enclosed.
model_answer:
18, MG Road
Bengaluru 560001
14 November 2026
The Manager
Techno World
Brigade Road, Bengaluru
Subject: Complaint about a defective laptop (Bill No. TW/4521)
Sir/Madam,
I am writing to express my dissatisfaction with a laptop I purchased from your showroom on 2 November 2026.
Within a week of purchase the screen began to flicker every few minutes, making it impossible to work for long. The battery, which was promised to last eight hours, now drains completely in about an hour. I have followed the troubleshooting steps suggested by your helpline, but the problems persist. As a student preparing for the board examinations, I depend on this laptop daily, and the fault has caused me great inconvenience.
I request you to replace the laptop with a new unit or refund the full amount within ten days. A copy of the bill is enclosed for your reference.
I look forward to a prompt resolution.
Yours sincerely,
Kavya

scheme.step: Format: addresses, date, subject with bill number, salutation, close, name
Content: item, date of purchase, bill number, both defects, inconvenience caused
Content: remedy (replacement or refund) within a time frame; bill enclosed
Expression: firm but polite tone, coherent paragraphs
Expression: grammar, spelling, 120–150 words

label: PYQ-style

label: PYQ-style
stem: You are Mohit/Mohini, Head Boy/Head Girl of St. Xavier's School, Ranchi. Students crossing the busy road outside the school face danger every day as there is no traffic signal or zebra crossing. Write a letter in 120–150 words to the Commissioner of Police requesting a traffic signal, a zebra crossing and a traffic constable during school hours.
hint: Receiver: The Commissioner of Police, Ranchi. P2: the danger with specifics (busy road, speeding vehicles, 1,500 students, near-misses). P3: the three requests, polite close.
model_answer:
St. Xavier's School
Doranda, Ranchi 834002
14 November 2026
The Commissioner of Police
Ranchi
Subject: Request for traffic safety measures outside St. Xavier's School
Sir,
On behalf of the students of St. Xavier's School, I wish to draw your attention to the danger students face while crossing the main road outside the school gate.
Nearly 1,500 students cross this road every morning and afternoon. Vehicles speed past without slowing down, and there is neither a traffic signal nor a zebra crossing. Last week two students narrowly escaped being hit by a bus. Parents and teachers are deeply worried, and the problem is worst during the dispersal rush at 2 p.m.
I request you to install a traffic signal and a zebra crossing near the gate and to post a traffic constable during school hours. A speed-limit board would also help.
I hope you will take prompt action to protect the children.
Yours sincerely,
Mohini
Head Girl

scheme.step: Format: addresses, date, receiver's designation, subject, salutation, close, name with designation
Content: purpose and the danger with specifics (numbers, speeding, no signal or crossing, near-miss)
Content: the three requests clearly stated; polite hope for action
Expression: formal, respectful tone and coherence
Expression: grammar, spelling, 120–150 words
